beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A later correction can then identify which claims and dependencies it affects.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: This is a proposal about scientific meaning, not merely a different file format.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Chapter three develops why the object needs both versioning and an explicit theory of identity.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Consider a measurement whose calibration is corrected after several analyses already used it.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A conventional final report may not reveal every conclusion depending on that measurement.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The proposed workbench preserves dependencies so those affected claims can be located.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Only the relevant work should need recomputation, with the reason for change retained.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The example shows why memory must include relationships rather than just accumulated documents.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It also exposes a testable requirement for the architecture being proposed.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Does the added structure actually make a bounded correction easier to carry through?

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: An executable specification should not freeze research into one unquestioned sequence.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book describes controlled expansion into rival hypotheses, baselines, controls and replications.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Each branch has a purpose, an evidence role and conditions for stopping.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Generation, search, evaluation and experimentation remain distinct responsibilities within the process.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A useful negative result may redirect the portfolio instead of counting as wasted effort.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The workbench must preserve that possibility through failures and incomplete branches.
